title: Ruleset: movies
description: rules/<id>/movies.yaml: the movie each moment of the game plays, whether Start skips it, and how long the title waits before the boot movie again (apps/game: MovieRules, docs/architecture/peliculas.md).

file.description: The movie folder in the packs: movie/<file>/.

skippable.description: Whether the Start action ends it early.

boot.description: At start and when the title is idle.

new_game.description: Before a new game's first map.

cleared_load.description: On continuing a game saved after the ending.

ending.description: After the ending, before the title.

landing_idle_frames.description: Frames at 60 a second without input on the title before the boot movie plays again.
